comment: Commits CI uses (.github/actions/ctm-dependencies and site.yml; a head commit's CTM-Review-Refs trailer names others for review). ctm-libs: the library of CTM Assessment (the Python runtime, AI feedback, the bootstrap's target; its runtime/pyodide-sympy.json is the SymPy that requirements.txt pins, checked by host-sympy.yml). ctm-checkers: the Python checker library with the STACK engine (ctm_checkers.stack), its example questions (examples/stack, copied into questions/ by scripts/fetch-examples.py) and the native STACK workflow that renders the compliance report. ctm-assessment: the umbrella, for tools/ci/review-dependencies.py (the one copy of every CTM repository).
